# Wire bytes of the play packets Warp reads and writes to switch servers before 1.20.2, without
# their packet ID: "<protocol> <packet> <hex>". Written by node-minecraft-protocol 1.68.0 with
# minecraft-data 3.117.0, an implementation independent of Warp, from generate-switch-packets.cjs
# (next to this file): node generate-switch-packets.cjs > switch-packets.txt, with the e2e/
# dependencies installed.
#
# Every Join Game puts entity 42 in adventure mode in the overworld (hashed seed 0x0102030405060708,
# 20 players, view distance 10); from 1.16 with a small registry that uses every NBT tag type,
# previous game mode -1, a superflat world, from 1.19 a last death location and from 1.20 a portal
# cooldown of 3. Each "respawn" is the Respawn into that same world, keeping nothing: what Warp
# must send after it. Tab list entries are 5c39a8cb-1a3a-4c86-9a47-0f0aaf0e3a01 (Alice) and
# 0f3e1b7c-7b5d-4b55-8e0a-2c3d4e5f6a7b (Bob); the boss bar is the first of these UUIDs. On 1.7 the
# tab list is keyed by name: Alice, and Bob with a colour code.
